Game Overview

In Battle of the Battles, the core idea is straightforward: strategize your way to victory in Battle of the Battles. Lead Marin through an intense arcade-style tournament by predicting opponent moves and concealing your position. With vivid characters, engaging puzzles, and intuitive controls, outwit the Renegades and channel your inner tactician to secure the ultimate triumph.
